name: Ree
hail: Bright Child, you've been loud for a while. Lovely to meet you properly.
Hello from Ree, little one. Everything we have is on the table. Help yourself.

close: With love, and far too many opinions. Ree.
Light in your sails, Bright Child. Ree.
